title: FORGETTING THE PAIN, FRUITFUL IN SUFFERING

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Before the years of famine came, two sons were born to Joseph by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On. Joseph named his firstborn Manasseh and said, 'It is because God has made me forget all my trouble and all my father's household.' The second son he named Ephraim and said, 'It is because God has made me fruitful in the land of my suffering.'" - Gen 41:50-52 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Joseph has two sons, and the names he gives them are a window into his healing heart. The first he calls Manasseh — "God has made me forget all my trouble." The second he calls Ephraim — "God has made me fruitful in the land of my suffering." In these two names, Joseph gives all the credit to God for two beautiful works of grace in his life.

Manasseh speaks of healing. Joseph does not mean he literally forgot his brothers' betrayal or his years of pain — but that God had released him from the grip of those wounds. The bitterness that could have consumed him had been healed. God had so filled his heart with new joy that the old pain no longer ruled him.

Ephraim speaks of fruitfulness. Notice where the fruit came: "in the land of my suffering." God did not merely bring Joseph out of his suffering; He brought fruit out of it. Egypt, the place of his slavery and prison, became the place of his flourishing. God did not waste one moment of Joseph's pain.

Here is the double grace God offers those who trust Him through suffering: He heals the wounds that would embitter us, and He brings fruit out of the very places where we hurt. Whatever your "land of suffering," God can do the same — freeing your heart from bitterness and bringing forth fruit right there. Give Him time, and give Him thanks.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Is there pain I need God to free me from the grip of?
2. Where might God be bringing fruit out of my "land of suffering"?
3. Can I, like Joseph, give God the credit for healing and fruitfulness?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, free my heart from the grip of old wounds, and bring forth fruit even in my places of suffering. Thank You that You waste no pain, but redeem it all by Your grace. Amen.
